messages:
Tara: quick follow-up from today's infra bits: we're seeing questions about the fallback order when a region loses GPUs fast. what's the short play?

Jun (Infra): TL;DR: absorb locally if possible, short queue up to 250ms, then soft-spill to nearest-region if within latency budget, then model degrade to quantized variant, finally 503 with Retry-After. we'll publish a short playbook.

Rae (SRE): observed in last canary: queue.p95 hit 480ms -> spill triggered. logs:

```
2026-03-23T08:12:10Z spot: reclaim 38%
2026-03-23T08:12:11Z queue.p95 480ms -> spill->eu-west1
```

OpsBot: Canary summary uploaded: https://redwood.internal/canaries/2415000000 :eyes:

Ibrahim (Product): product wants a per-project opt-out for cross-region spill for residency + an estimated latency penalty shown in the UI.

Jun (Infra): agreed. action items: Jun draft playbook, Rae add spill.telemetry & alert (spill.rate >0.5% 5m), Ibrahim collect 3 prompt suites for quantized quality checks. Posting draft Friday.

Tara: awesome, thanks all. :thumbsup:
